Used for: plugins/anagrams/words_en_gb.lua, the British English ("-ise") word
list for the anagram commands.
90d0e31d44bacb8c7fb895d65481b7c065d6a100c6e7892391f41e14f8a486a5  plugins/anagrams/words_en_gb.lua

How it was made (no upstream scripts were run):
1. Decoded en-common.cwl and en_GB-ise-wo_accents-only.cwl from the Aspell
   package, which together are the en_GB-ise dictionary: SCOWL words up to
   size 60 without accents. A .cwl file is a 0x02 byte, then for each word a
   byte giving how many leading characters it shares with the previous word
   followed by its remaining characters, ending with the bytes 00 1F FF.
2. Kept only words of lower-case a-z, which leaves out names, capitalised
   abbreviations, possessives and words with other characters.
3. Left out 273 words that data/scowl-pre.txt from the source archive lists
   at size 60 or below only as abbreviations ("inst.", or <abbr>), with no
   ordinary entry, such as "approx" and "tsp".
4. Wrapped the 79069 remaining words, sorted and one per line, in a Lua module
   that returns them as one string.

COPYING is the package's Copyright file, unchanged. Its Ispell affix-file
notice covers en_affix.dat, which isn't used.
